messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: high error rate: GPU OOMs in cluster us-east-1 decode pool (decode-*) — 7 OOMs in last 6m. Severity: P1. Paging oncall.
Ashwin (oncall): ack — I'm jumping in. seeing continuous CUDA OOMs on decode-3/4 nodes, most tied to streaming sessions that keep growing. tagging @Liam and @Maya.
Ashwin (oncall): quick snapshot from node decode-3 logs:
```
[2026-03-15T02:10:12Z] ERROR runtime::decode: CUDA free failed: out of memory (node decode-3)
... kv_cache_size=0.00GB active_streams=9 max_stream_length=unbounded
trace: decode_loop -> allocate_kv -> cudaMalloc -> OOM
```
Liam (EngRuntime): looks like a missing max_tokens enforcement — some clients are sending token_limit=null and streaming keeps appending. logs show multiple streams > 100k tokens in 10m. that will blow the kv cache.
Maya (SRE): customer impact? @Sofia can you correlate errors -> customer ids?
Sofia (Support): checking now — early correlate: acme-corp and beta-ux both have elevated error rates. acme-corp ~3.2% of requests dropped in the last 10m, several retries from their side. forwarding sample request IDs: rq_85a2, rq_85a7.
Ashwin (oncall): mitigation plan (immediate):
 - enforce global streaming token cap at the LB layer to 2048 tokens
 - enable model fallback route to cpu-decode for sessions that exceed 8s of continuous generation
 - throttle new streaming sessions from known high-throughput tenants (acme-corp) by 50%
 - restart decode pods one-by-one to reclaim fragmented GPU memory (rolling restart)
I'll start applying the caps now.
Liam (EngRuntime): adding to that — push a hotpatch to runtime to reject null max_tokens for streaming with a 1s fail-open window, and emit metric token_limit_missing. I'll push a guarded flag; we can rollback quickly.
Ashwin (oncall): running commands:
```bash
# cap at edge LB
redwoodctl routes update --match "/v1/stream" --set "max_tokens=2048"
# throttle tenant acme-corp
redwoodctl quota set --tenant acme-corp --route "/v1/stream" --rate 50%
```
deploy-bot: deploy started: runtime-hotfix/token-cap (rev be9d3) by Liam — expected 2m to rollout.
Ashwin (oncall): performed rolling restart on decode-3 -> decode-6, restarted one node so far (decode-3). memory frag reduced on decode-3, new allocations succeeding.
Maya (SRE): observed drop in OOMs after LB cap and first restart. OOMs per 5m: before 7 -> now 1. keep rolling. also notify support for customer comms.
Sofia (Support): drafting message for acme-corp — include apology + mitigation + asking for request IDs if still failing. ETA to send: 15m after we confirm stable.
Liam (EngRuntime): hotfix successfully rolled to 60% of runtime fleet, token_limit_missing metric now spiking (good). will increase to 100% in 5m if stable.
Ashwin (oncall): follow-up mitigation: temporarily route streaming > 6k tokens to smaller quantized model (rq-fallback) to shed GPU memory pressure. enabling on path.
Ashwin (oncall): logs show one residual node (decode-7) still thrashing; cordon and drain for deeper investigation.
Maya (SRE): double-check GPU driver versions on decode-7, fragmentation + older driver can exacerbate OOMs. Liam, can you capture a heap profile after drain?
Liam (EngRuntime): will run `nvprof` + dump allocator stats and post.
Ashwin (oncall): handing off long-running follow-up to Maya for root-cause and postmortem. my oncall shift ends in ~40m. leaving runbook notes in incident doc.
Maya (SRE): taking over. immediate TODOs for follow-up:
 - full tenant request replay for acme-corp requests (rq_85a2, rq_85a7)
 - verify LB token cap metrics and add automatic cap enforcement for null max_tokens
 - confirm restart/drain ordering and node driver versions
 - coordinate postmortem with EngRuntime & Support
Ashwin (oncall): oncall-handoff @ 3345679400 — all mitigations active, monitoring steady.
Sofia (Support): prepared customer note, will wait for confirmation from Maya before sending.
Liam (EngRuntime): posted allocator snapshot to incident doc. initial hypothesis: token_limit missing + streaming clients with no user-side token guard -> KV cache growth + fragmentation -> OOM. patch and LB cap mitigated immediate impact.
Maya (SRE): thanks team. creating postmortem ticket and scheduling follow-up call. leaving a pinned checklist in the incident channel. :white_check_mark:
Ashwin (oncall): resolved for now — will move to monitoring for 24h and escalate if OOMs > 2/5m. great work y'all. :clap:
